name: Drow Assassin

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: A weapon of choice for the sophisticated duelist, the rapier is a long, light blade ideal for parrying blows and delivering quick counterattacks.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Combat Advantage
traits.details: The drow assassin deals 2d6 extra damage on melee and ranged attacks against any target it has combat advantage against.

effect.description: The drow assassin makes a rapier or hand crossbow attack, shifts up to 2 squares, then makes another rapier or hand crossbow attack.

hit.description: poison damage, and ongoing 10 poison damage (save ends).

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: Increase the ongoing poison damage by 5

effect.description: this power creates a cloud of darkness that remains in place until the end of the drow assassin’s next turn. The cloud blocks line of sight for all creatures except the drow assassin. Any creature entirely within the cloud (except the drow assassin) is blinded until it exits.
The drow assassin’s cloud of darkness power recharges, and the drow assassin uses it immediately.

powers.name: Stealth Shift
powers.trigger: when an attack misses the drow assassin and the drow assassin is hidden from the attacker
